anchor: Which wearable headgear can unleash a random magic effect, such as a ball of flame or a cloud of foul vapor, or leave its wearer dazed?
Which headpiece makes me roll percentile dice, and on a result in the low fifties leaves me reeling and unable to act until my next turn ends?
Which uncommon protective gear with an eye emblem gives me an edge on rolls to act first and to notice hidden things?
What class power lets me hand an ally a six-sided die they can add to a failed ability roll, using a quick move within 60 feet?
My minstrel has Charisma 16; how many boosts can they give allies before a full night's sleep restores them, and how big do the dice grow by level 10?
What divine support spell lets me lift up to three friends' attack and resistance rolls by a small random amount, lasting up to a minute?
As a cleric with a spare high-level slot, how many extra companions can I empower with a divine boost, and does it demand sustained focus?
Which rare drink makes me shrink for 1d4 hours with no need to maintain focus, and its red liquid forms a tiny bead?
Will shaking the bottle of a red-tinted drink stop its magic from working inside it?
Which creature takes the form of a Medium or Small object, sticks to anyone touching it, and deals corrosive harm with its bite?
Which 58-hit-point monster with 60-foot sight in darkness can't be knocked down and has Strength 17?
My warlock is level 20. Which capstone feature refills every one of my pact-powered slots when I use my signature ability?
Which large beast with 13 hit points and a 60-foot speed attacks with hooves, dealing 7 damage on a hit?
Which large, barely-thinking creature has a Strength of 16 and only a Passive Perception of 10?
Which creature with Charisma-based magic at DC 16 can change the weather and read surface thoughts once a day each?
Which creature, acting right after another creature's turn, uses an agility roll at DC 16 to hit targets 120 feet away with fire and slow them?
Stacking up fatigue: at what total level does it kill a character, and how much does each level lower their d20 rolls?
How much rest clears one level of this worn-down state, and how many feet does each level shave off my walking speed?
Which druid level 8 transformation lets me turn several willing friends into beasts of challenge rating 4 or lower for 24 hours?
If I turn a companion into a beast, can it still cast spells, and does it keep its own mind and hit points?
Which level 2 ranged attack shoots a green projectile that splashes corrosive damage immediately and again next turn?
If my green bolt misses, does any damage still land, and how much extra does each higher slot add?
Which level 5 monk power, costing a ki point after a hit, forces a Constitution roll that can leave a foe unable to act?
If a foe shrugs off my monk's disruptive blow, how is its movement hampered and what bonus do my next attacks get?
Which large, neutral evil creature resists life-draining harm and gets advantage on attacks when a friend is close to the target?
Which creature moves 10 feet on foot but 60 feet in the air, and its jabbing attack leaves the victim ill until its next turn ends?
When magic that sends someone's spirit away wears off for a living person, how do they leave suspended animation?
Which slime-like monster ruins my arrows on contact, weakens my blades with each hit, and shrugs off cold and fire?
Which pudding-like creature perceives nearby things without eyes within 60 feet, slides through one-inch gaps, and can't be knocked down or seized?
Which very rare magic blade grants +2 on hit and damage rolls and lets me strike once more as a quick extra action each turn?
What curved weapon of rare power needs me to bond with it before its bonuses work, boosting hit and damage by two?
On this device for liquids, what happens to its back opening when I pull lever 10 up?
If I push lever 9 down, how far does this underwater machine move in liquid, and which direction?
Which monster's Strength-based gulp pulls a Medium-or-smaller foe within 5 feet inside, blinding it and dealing 10 electric damage each turn?
Which monster can haul one captured victim along for free whenever it walks, and can only hold a single captive at once?
Which touch-cast protection lasts 8 hours and makes the next fatal drop to zero leave an ally at 1 hit point instead?
What happens if a no-damage instant-kill effect targets an ally already shielded by my earlier touch?
Which monster's second bellow, reaching 500 feet, freezes foes in place, letting each retry a Wisdom roll at DC 20 at turn end?
Which creature can blink up to 30 feet to a visible empty spot, then swipe with its claws right after another creature's turn ends?
Which huge plant-creature deals double damage to buildings and can animate up to two trees once per day?
Which huge chaotic good creature with 138 hit points hurls wooden shards for 28 damage out to 180 feet?
Which tiny two-hit-point beast climbs 40 feet and leaps based on agility instead of brute strength?
What tiny creature sees 60 feet in the dark, notices things at a passive 13, and scratches for just 1 damage?
At druid level 3, what costs a shape-change use and creates a 10-foot burst of thorns, hurting foes and healing one friend?
How do the damage and healing of this druid burst grow as I climb past levels 10 and 14?
Which magical handheld item can freeze a foe I hit in melee, on a failed DC 17 Constitution roll, recharging at dawn?
Which enchanted hand tool makes every creature within 30 feet that I can see cower in fear on a failed DC 17 Wisdom roll?
Which random-effect magical stick, on a roll of 78 to 82, sends a 30-foot burst of shimmering light that blinds creatures failing a DC 15 Constitution roll?
What medium beast swims 40 feet, senses nearby things without sight out to 10 feet, and bites for toxic damage?
Which nimble creature with 11 hit points and an 18 Dexterity score has a Charisma of only 3?
What first-level magic sphere lets me pick a damage kind like fire or thunder for 3d8, and can jump to another foe on matching dice?
If I use a higher-level slot for my energy missile, how many extra leaps can it make, and can it hit the same foe twice?
Which uncommon gem lets a caster who's bonded with it use an action to recover one used magic slot up to third level, once until dawn?
Which Wisdom-based way of looking for hidden things helps me sense a creature's mood, or find tracks and food?
A fallen traveler lies nearby; which sense-based check reveals how they died or what illness they carried?
Which seventh-level touch magic hides a willing creature in suspended animation, invisible to scrying, and ends if the target takes any harm?
Which costly gem dust is consumed to lock an object away from detection, ending only when my chosen condition happens within a mile?
At paladin level 11, what adds an extra 1d8 of holy-light harm whenever my melee or fist attack lands?
Which second-level sensing magic detects hidden mechanical snares and danger devices within 120 feet in sight, but not their location?
Does this sense-danger magic reveal a natural sinkhole or unstable ceiling, or only man-made danger devices?
At paladin level 5, which feature lets me always keep an otherworldly mount ready and summon it for free once after a full night's sleep?
Which large prehistoric predator with 51 hit points can knock a target prone with its claws after running at it 30 feet straight?
What large predator with Strength 19 and a 15-damage bite has passive perception 15 and only 2 intelligence?
As a first-level sorcerer, how many minor tricks, prepared magic and first-tier slots do I start with?
What do I gain at sorcerer level 2 beyond my magic slots: a points pool of 2 and a way to reshape my magic?
Which chaotic evil fey can breathe underwater and air, and frighten beasts or humanoids who see its true form within 30 feet?
Which creature can cast knowledge-finding magic only while two kin stand within 30 feet, needing a full rest before repeating?
Which very rare tome of fitness training raises Strength by 2 after 48 hours of study over six days or fewer, to a maximum of 30?
Once a magic training volume has paid out its strength gain, how long until it works again?
Which faith-driven humanoid swings a curved blade for a little life-draining harm and is good at lying?
Which small-or-medium neutral humanoid has 9 hit points, 12 Dexterity, and wears leather armor for protection?
As a first-level cleric, which sacred path gives me heavy armor and battle weapon training, and which one gives an extra minor trick plus a lore bonus?
Which first-level cleric path boosts my lore checks by my intuition modifier, with a minimum of +1?
